description_en: Creates an order for resource occupation fees by calling the CreatePhysicalConnectionOccupancyOrder operation
description_zh: 调用CreatePhysicalConnectionOccupancyOrder接口创建资源占用费用的订单
name: CreatePhysicalConnectionOccupancyOrder

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Express Connect circuit
parameters.name: physical_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration.

If PricingCycle is set to Month, valid values of Period are 1 to 9.
If PricingCycle is set to Year, valid values of Period are 1 to 5
parameters.help_zh:
购买时长。

当PricingCycle取值Month时，Period取值范围为1～9。
当PricingCycle取值Year时，Period取值范围为1～5
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription. If you select this billing method, make sure that your Alibaba Cloud account supports balance payment or credit payment
parameters.help_zh:
实例的付费方式。取值：

PrePaid：预付费，包年包月。选择该类付费方式时，您必须确认您阿里云账号支持余额支付或信用支付
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: enables automatic payment. Make sure that your account balance is sufficient. If your account balance is insufficient, an abnormal order is generated and can only be canceled.
false (default): generates an order without charging
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付。取值：

true：自动支付。您需要确保账户余额充足，如果账户余额不足会生成异常订单，只能作废订单。
false（默认值）：只生成订单不扣费
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle of the subscription. Valid values:

Month (default): billed on a monthly basis.
Year: billed on a yearly basis
parameters.help_zh:
预付费的计费周期，取值：

Month（默认值）：按月购买。
Year：按年购买
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value. The value must be unique among different requests
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

false (default): disables auto-renewal.
true: enables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
是否开通自动续费。取值：

false（默认值）：不开通。
true：开通
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en: The auto-renewal duration. Unit: months. Valid values: 0 to 2147483647. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 自动续费时长。单位：月。取值范围：0~2147483647。默认值：1
parameters.name: auto_renew_duration
